The binomial coefficient $(\frac{n}{r})$ is given by the formula

$$
(\frac{n}{r})=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

In this case, we have $n=5$ and $r=3.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}(\frac{5}{3}) & =\frac{5!}{(5-3)!\cdot 3!} \\  & =\frac{5\cdot 4\cdot 3!}{2!\cdot 3!} \\  & =\frac{5\cdot 4\cdot \cancel{3!}}{2\cdot \cancel{3!}} \\  & =\frac{20}{2} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
